records.source_rule: A Duplicitous Value Clue that meets Minimum Clue Value Principle from other valuable cards calls for no further Prompt or blind-play.
records.learning_objective: Stop the connection after a duplicated direct play when the clue already has sufficient independent value.
records.critical_variable: The other newly touched 3 independently satisfies Minimum Clue Value Principle.
records.blind_answer: No further Prompt or blind-play is called for; the other 3 is only saved as useful.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Calling another connection ignores the explicit sufficient-value stopping rule.
records.actor_direct_alternative: N/A: Bob is interpreting the revealed duplicate.
records.mutation: Remove the independent value from the other touched card and the clue no longer qualifies as a Duplicitous Value Clue.
records.noise: The post-play state hides Bob's removed duplicate and retains only rank knowledge on the other touched 3.
records.timeline: pass: red 3 is already on the stack and Alice is no longer shown giving a current clue

records.source_rule: A duplicitous clue with no extra newly touched value but a filled-in card revealed playable is retroactively a Duplicitous Tempo Clue.
records.learning_objective: Distinguish Duplicitous Tempo from Duplicitous Value after the duplicate reveals.
records.critical_variable: No other new valuable card was touched, while the previously touched green card is filled in as playable green 2.
records.blind_answer: Interpret the clue as a Duplicitous Tempo Clue.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Duplicitous Value lacks the required independent newly touched value.
records.mutation: Add another newly touched valuable card meeting Minimum Clue Value Principle and the interpretation changes to Duplicitous Value.
records.noise: Only knowledge Bob legitimately has after the reveal remains in his hand state.
records.timeline: pass: the duplicate red 2 is already played and the current-clue arrow is removed

records.source_rule: Duplicitous Tempo Clues use the same Chop Move conditions as ordinary Tempo Clues.
records.learning_objective: Reject an extra Chop Move when the Tempo Clue is a legal stall.
records.critical_variable: Alice is in a valid Stalling Situation at the applicable precedence.
records.blind_answer: Do not Chop Move merely because the focused play was duplicated.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Duplication does not create a separate Chop Move rule when ordinary Tempo conditions explain the clue.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob could incorrectly Chop Move; that is the rejected interpretation.
records.mutation: Remove the valid stall and make the Tempo non-Valuable; the same position becomes a Tempo Clue Chop Move.
records.noise: The post-reveal diagram does not label the chop outcome.

records.source_rule: A duplicated blind-play through Unknown Trash Discharge with no extra touched value can signal an Assisted Trash Chop Move on cards right of the clued trash.
records.learning_objective: Apply Assisted Trash Chop Move boundaries through UTD.
records.critical_variable: The clued trash is on Cathy's slot 2 and no additional value explains the duplicated blind-play.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Stopping at ordinary UTD leaves the otherwise wasteful duplicate unexplained.
records.actor_direct_alternative: N/A: Cathy is updating the Chop Move state after Bob's reaction.
records.mutation: Touch a separate valuable card and the duplicate can instead have a Duplicitous Value explanation.
records.noise: The duplicated yellow 1 is already on the stack and Cathy's hidden rank is not exposed.

records.source_rule: A Duplicitous Tempo Clue causes a Tempo Clue Chop Move under the ordinary Tempo Clue Chop Move conditions.
records.learning_objective: Apply the non-stall, non-Valuable boundary after a duplicate reveal.
records.critical_variable: Alice is not stalling and the single unit of Tempo is not Valuable.
records.blind_answer: Yes; Bob also Chop Moves his chop.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: A no-Chop answer would ignore the ordinary Tempo Clue Chop Move conditions that still govern duplicitous tempo.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob can leave chop unmoved; that is the rejected alternative.
records.mutation: Make the clue a valid stall and the Chop Move disappears.
records.noise: The question diagram stays neutral and does not pre-mark chop.
records.timeline: pass: duplicate has already revealed and played

records.source_rule: Blind-form Time Travel Chop Move requires a duplicitous blind-play that fails Minimum Clue Value Principle and does not look like an Assisted Trash Chop Move.
records.learning_objective: Recognize the blind form only after both blockers are ruled out.
records.critical_variable: The duplicated blind-play is a genuine 0-for-1 with neither sufficient value nor Assisted Trash Chop Move interpretation.
records.blind_answer: Interpret it as a Time Travel Chop Move on Bob's own cards behind the played duplicate.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Any ordinary duplicitous-value or assisted-chop explanation is explicitly excluded by the premises.
records.mutation: Add enough newly secured value and the same duplicate becomes a Duplicitous Blind-Play instead.
records.noise: Bob's played blue 2 has left his hand and the historical clue is no longer rendered as current.

records.source_rule: A direct duplicitous clue that is a 0-for-1 and gives no useful Tempo becomes a Time Travel Chop Move on cards behind the duplicated card.
records.learning_objective: Recognize direct Time Travel after the duplicated direct play reveals.
records.critical_variable: The clue gains no extra card and provides no useful Tempo.
records.blind_answer: Chop Move the cards behind the played red 3.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Without extra value or Tempo there is no ordinary duplicitous explanation left.
records.mutation: Add an independently valuable touched 3 and the clue becomes Duplicitous Value instead.
records.noise: The red 3 is already on the stack; Bob's replacement hand is masked.

records.source_rule: A duplicated Trash Finesse blind-play with no extra touched value can signal Assisted Trash Chop Move on cards right of the clued trash.
records.learning_objective: Apply Assisted Trash Chop Move from the Trash Finesse form.
records.critical_variable: Cathy's clued trash is slot 3 and no additional card value explains Bob's duplicated blind-play.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: The duplicate is otherwise unexplained, so treating the clue as only a Trash Finesse misses the assisted message.
records.actor_direct_alternative: N/A: Cathy updates her Chop Move state.
records.mutation: Move the clued trash one slot left and the moved suffix grows accordingly.
records.noise: Cathy retains only rank-1 knowledge rather than objective blue-1 identity.
records.timeline: pass: duplicate yellow 1 is already on the stack

records.source_rule: Blind-form Time Travel is blocked when the clue satisfies Minimum Clue Value Principle; then the duplicate is a normal Duplicitous Blind-Play.
records.learning_objective: Use Minimum Clue Value Principle as the blocking boundary for blind Time Travel.
records.critical_variable: A separate newly secured valuable 3 satisfies Minimum Clue Value Principle.
records.blind_answer: Do not add Time Travel; interpret the duplicate as a Duplicitous Blind-Play.
records.opposite_answer_breaker: Time Travel explicitly requires failing Minimum Clue Value Principle.
records.actor_direct_alternative: Bob can incorrectly Chop Move his own hand; that is the rejected alternative.
records.mutation: Remove the separate valuable 3 and the Time Travel interpretation can become available if Assisted Trash Chop Move is also excluded.
